regime_context: The detector shows a two-theme rotation: Memory/HBM/Storage leads by raw momentum score (2.198) but is NOT eligible (durability_bar 0.28, breadth 0.0 — leadership has thinned to nothing), while US Energy Complex is the eligible challenger (score 1.442, eligible=true, breadth 0.682, durability 0.6, not crowded). The eligible universe is narrowing (23/49, frac 0.47), one_narrative is false, and the broad defensive complex (Healthcare, Staples, Utilities, Materials, Insurance) is crowded but trend-healthy. No new-theme call until a top-5 eligible theme shows breadth expansion from a non-crowded base.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is the highest-ranked ELIGIBLE theme (rank 2, score 1.442) with the trend gate's absolute-trend discipline active, durability_bar 0.6 (mixed Hurst but confirming val_state), breadth 0.682, and crowding_z 0.81 not flagged crowded. The validated edge is whipsaw/drawdown avoidance via the gate, and this is the strongest theme that passes it. Leadership is also rotation-challenger (margin to leader 0.756 but leader ineligible). Lean is a conditional stay-in, not a momentum claim.
theses.dissent: Energy is a mixed Hurst regime, not a clean trend; it is challenger, not leader, and the raw leader (Memory) has decayed — if the whole commodities/energy narrative is just a rotation vacuum filler, it can mean-revert hard from here. Momentum rank-IC is ~0, so the 'rank 2' tells us little about forward return.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the highest-durability eligible trend (durability_bar 0.77, hurst_tag=trend, breadth 0.778, eligible=true), which is the exact profile the validated absolute-trend gate rewards — sustained trend health without drawdown. Crowding_z 1.56 (crowded=true) is a SIZE-DOWN caution, not a reason to avoid; it signals strong trend persistence but demands humility on entry.
theses.dissent: It is the most crowded theme in the top decile, and crowding/extension marks attention peaks; a crowded defensives trade can grind slowly or get sold off when risk appetite returns to cyclicals. No forward edge from rank.

falsifier.text: PPH underperforms SPY by more than 3% over the 20-day horizon, or big_pharma crowding_z rises above 2.0 while breadth falls below 0.6

theses.thesis: Memory/HBM leads the raw momentum rank (score 2.198, rank 1) but is NOT trend-gate eligible, with durability_bar only 0.28 and breadth 0.0 — zero participation/cohesion.
